metadata.description: Skills that go with Immons.Tools.Maui.Inspector, the in-app DevTools for .NET MAUI

plugins.name: maui-inspector
plugins.description: Hunting managed memory leaks in .NET MAUI apps: the two-snapshot rule, reading GC-root chains, the recurring causes (long-lived events, undisconnected handlers, cached views, the iOS cell-size cache) and how to drive the inspector's HTTP API.
